d:
The society faces a complete water shortage after the main tank runs dry. Bhide scrambles to book a water tanker, but due to high demand, the supplier charges extra and schedules delivery for late afternoon. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka takes a day off from Gada Electronics to go swimming at Juhu Beach because his area has no water either.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
